SET:F_j.meaning: fire channels belonging to weapon system j

SET:F_n.meaning: fire channels located on platform n

SET:BS_f.meaning: blind sectors of fire channel f

SET:U_ift.meaning: radar illumination alternatives associated with engagement (i,f,t)

PARAM:PK_i.meaning: hit probability of threat i against its target platform before defensive engagements

PARAM:p_ift.meaning: single-shot kill probability if fire channel f engages threat i starting at time t

PARAM:q_if.meaning: earliest beginning time of first feasible engagement for pair (i,f)

PARAM:l_if.meaning: latest ending time of last feasible engagement for pair (i,f)

PARAM:Delta_ift.meaning: duration of engagement (i,f) when starting at time t

PARAM:d_j.meaning: available rounds on weapon system j

PARAM:s_j.meaning: setup time between consecutive fires from weapon system j

PARAM:s_r.meaning: setup time needed by radar r for tracking/illumination

PARAM:mu_if.meaning: upper bound on engagements from fire channel f against threat i under the selected firing policy

PARAM:rt_i.meaning: time that threat i reaches its target

PARAM:h_n0.meaning: initial true heading of ship n

PARAM:mr_n.meaning: maximum turn rate of ship n per time slot

PARAM:theta_int.meaning: true bearing of threat i from ship n at time t

PARAM:bss_fb.meaning: start/end angles of blind sector b of fire channel f

PARAM:bse_fb.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

PARAM:rcs_i_alpha.meaning: miss probability / bearing-dependent hit-related parameter for threat i at bearing alpha

VAR:Y_ift.meaning: 1 if fire channel f is scheduled to start an engagement against threat i at time t

VAR:Z_ift.meaning: 1 if the radar of fire channel f is assigned to threat i at time t

VAR:PS_ift.meaning: probability that the platform carrying fire channel f survives until engagement (i,f,t) can be completed

VAR:H_nt.meaning: heading of ship n at time t

VAR:HG_nt.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

VAR:B_nit.meaning: relative bearing of threat i from ship n at time t

VAR:FA_nit.meaning: binary auxiliaries for bearing, blind sector and bearing-category logic

VAR:FG_ifbt.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

VAR:FS_ifbt.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

VAR:BR_i_alpha.meaning: split registry entry for grouped source item

OBJ:OBJ1.meaning: minimize value-weighted hit probability of threats after scheduled engagements, with engagement success discounted by platform survival

CONGRP:WEAPON_ROUNDS.meaning: total scheduled engagements using weapon system j do not exceed available rounds d_j

CONGRP:ENGAGEMENT_BOUND.meaning: engagement count upper bound per threat-fire-channel pair under SLS/modified SLS firing policy

CONGRP:SCHEDULING_CONFLICT.meaning: prevent incompatible simultaneous engagements for the same threat/time and same weapon system/time window

CONGRP:RADAR_ILLUMINATION.meaning: scheduled engagement requires compatible radar illumination and radar setup conflict avoidance

CONGRP:SHIP_HEADING.meaning: initial heading, turn-rate limits and wraparound logic for ship headings

CONGRP:BLIND_SECTOR.meaning: relative bearing and fire-channel blind-sector exclusion logic

CONGRP:PLATFORM_SURVIVAL.meaning: compute platform survival probability by multiplying miss/survival terms of threats expected to hit the platform before engagement completion; fixed previous engagements enter this calculation

CONGRP:VARIABLE_DOMAINS.meaning: binary and continuous domains for Y, Z, H, auxiliaries, PS and PK

SEMANTIC:DYNAMIC_UPDATE.meaning: dynamic update or staged wrapper semantics

SEMANTIC:unsupported_generic_target_valu.meaning: generic target value reward without PK/survival residual hit probability

SEMANTIC:unsupported_generic_sensor_weap.meaning: generic sensor-weapon-target compatibility matrix as substitute for fire-channel/radar/heading/blind-sector logic

SEMANTIC:unsupported_omitting_platform_s.meaning: omitting platform survival PS_ift in the dynamic objective
